summary: Per-frame vehicle physics initializer: loads per-corner suspension setup data, computes ride-height/weight-distribution/center-of-mass, builds the body-coupling transforms and corner force structures, then runs the per-element steering/relative-velocity/matrix update passes before returning the vehicle rotation matrix pointer. Called each frame from TireModelInit (0x0043E050).

operations.description: Entry: per-frame physics setup invoked from TireModelInit (0x0043E050).

Load corner setup blocks from vehicle config (this+0x1F00): copy four per-corner float triplets (ride-height/spring/damper data) from the corner setup arrays at this+0x1F00+0x8C8 area into stack locals.
Weighted sum of corner setup floats (distinct coefficients per corner) stored to this+0x1F34; rear/front ride-height adjustments applied from a3 offsets before the sum is finalized.
Per-corner loop (4 iterations, stride 0x128): call ThreeFieldSetterWithSubCall on each corner setup triplet.
Vehicle body sub-object (this+0x1D4): zero 0xAC/0xB4 and write 0x3FF00000 (1.875f) to 0xB0/0xB8 each frame; 0xAC/0xB0 subsequently overwritten with computed body mass and inverse mass.

Accumulate attached-body mass: iterate count this+0x15AC over body list base this+0x15B0 (stride 0x244), excluding this+0x15F0 index and self pointer this+0x1E8; store total mass to this+0x15F4 and write mass/inverse-mass into the corner struct at *(this+0x15F0)+0xAC / +0xB4.

Per-corner center-of-mass accumulation: iterate 4 corners over the this+0x3E8 body-pointer array (count this+0x3EC), summing mass moments; add coupled-body (this+0x141C) contributions using corner offsets read from *(this+0x1114)+0x4/0xC/0x14 and *(this+0xCB0)+0x4/0xC/0x14.
Compute center-of-mass / CG offset combining corner geometry with track-width read *(this+0x1F00)+0x76C and a3 ride-height inputs; final total mass stored on the vehicle body sub-object (this+0x1D4).
Write three per-corner force-result floats into the vehicle config struct at *(this+0x1F00)+0x738/0x73C/0x740 (converted from computed corner force values).
Write CG/anchor position deltas to this+0x1614/0x161C/0x1624 and to this+0x15F8; copy corner anchor vectors into the per-corner suspension force buffer through the *(this+0x15F0) array.
Tire compound selection: TireBrandLookup(a3+136); if brand set, CompoundIndexLookup(*(a2+3012)), else compound index 0.

Per-corner suspension setup loop (4 corners, stride 0x464): compound data drives VehicleSuspensionForceHelper for spring/damper, else defaults 275000.0 / 0.325; writes per-corner fields this+0x451..0x470 (activity flag, indices, damper rate, anti-roll) and reads corner suspension travel from *(this+0x3EC)+0xAC and *(this+0x141C)+0xAC.

Coupled-body center-of-gravity update: if this+0x141C set, read corner offsets via *(this+0x1114)+4 and *(this+0xCB0)+4, average against local corner positions, and write resulting CG into *(this+0x141C)+4.

Contact-pair loop (count this+0x15B4, base this+0x15B8, stride 48): TransformApply3D on contact points, F_3DVectorTransformBy33Matrix, F_3x3RotationTensorMatrixTransform and FloatConvertWrapper to build/normalize the coupling rotation.

Body-coupling loop (count this+0x15C4, base this+0x15C8, stride 72): TransformApply3D, F_3DVectorTransformBy33Matrix, Mat3x3MulVec and Matrix3x3VectorMultiply on coupled body pairs; intermediate written to this+0x1420.
Per-corner rotation setup loop (4 iterations, stride 0x464): EulerAnglesTo33RotationMatrix on a per-corner Euler buffer, then sub_56BDE0 on the corner slot at this+0x454.
Per-corner struct copy loop (4 iterations, stride 0x464): StructCopyWithReciprocalDivision on corner data at *(this+0x3E8)+188.
Copy center-of-mass from a3: this+0xD4/0xDC/0xE4 = a3+72/80/88; then subtract each attached body (count this+0x15AC, base this+0x15B0, stride 0x244) contribution from the COM values.
this+0x3EC == 0: vehicle has zero suspension travel, blocks suspension processing branches.
this+0x15AC > 0: suspension mode flag positive, gates suspension geometry computation.
this+0x15B4 <= 0 and this+0x15B4 > 0: front suspension travel bounds checks gate the front-suspension setup branch.
this+0x15BC > 0: front roll stiffness positive, passes into anti-roll bar computation.
this+0x15C4 > 0: front spring rate positive, passes into spring rate computation.
Invalid-dimension dev log: if any COM dimension <= 0 and session type != 5 (dword_7C569C), StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002, 2560) then DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aVehicleHasZero).
Front steering geometry pass: StructCopyWithReciprocalDivision on COM vector, then FrontSteeringGeometrySetup(a2, a3) and SteeringGeometryComputation(a2, a3).
Per-element update passes (count/base this+0x15C4/0x15C8, stride 72): RelativeVelocityCompute followed by sub_56D2D0 on each suspension element.
Contact transform passes: F_3x3MatrixVectorMultiply (count this+0x15B4, base this+0x15B8, stride 48) and F_3x3MatrixInverseCoordinateTransform (count this+0x15BC, base this+0x15C0, stride 48).
Tire model mode factor: if dword_7CE958 set, scale factors 0.605/0.73 are written to a3+1336 region, else 1.0/1.0.

Corner force/stiffness loop (4 corners, stride 0x464): rotation dot-products from *(this+0x3E8) corner structs written to this+0x400/0x420/0x428/0x430; per-corner static/dynamic force terms accumulated.
Zero angular state this+0x1428/0x142C and compute this+0x1430 (angular rate term from sqrt(a3+5752) * a3+104).
DeltaUpdateTracking(a2 setup) and CollisionEnergy(a2, a3) for collision impulse; scaled energy written to this+0x1448 and this+0x1450.

Final CG/corner sum: read corner offsets *(this+0x1114)+0x4/0xC/0x14 and *(this+0xCB0)+0x4/0xC/0x14, combine with vehicle rotation matrix (*(this+0x15F0)+28) and a3 COM/anchor offsets, store to this+0x1DFC.
Return pointer to the vehicle rotation matrix at *(this+0x15F0)+28.
